verdict.rationale: SolidJS is a framework you scaffold from its GitHub templates and run on your own client or server runtimes, including Node LTS, Deno and Cloudflare Workers, with full SSR support. So the core product runs on infrastructure you control. However, the evidence never states an open-source license or explicitly documents self-hosting, so full coverage is not established. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement, explicit self-hosting/deployment documentation, independent corroboration of self-hosted deployments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: For server environments, we support Node LTS and the latest Deno and Cloudflare Worker runtimes.
Solid has full SSR and serverless support, with streaming and progressive hydration to get to interactive as quickly as possible.
Isomorphic: render your components on the client and the server
